ruleText: the category prior of the WHOLE store (catdir.bin and catheads.txt, what the articles of each category are, counted from every visible first sentence, never a held-out one) is kept first, whole; then as cats-first: every article keeps its title and categories facts, articles in dump order; then its other facts breadth first in item order. The cap takes the longest prefix of that order whose store fits. Kept articles are written in dump order with their kept items in their original order, by KnowledgeWriter itself; signatures are copied; heldout.jsonl is copied whole so every pack is graded on the same questions.
capUnit: N MB = N x 1,000,000 bytes, summed over every file of the pack directory (meta.json and heldout.jsonl included)

development.what: the rule: core-rank, core-dump, cats-first, cats-prior, dump packed at the --dev caps and graded on the held-out records OUTSIDE the bar draw (bench/recall.mjs tuningRecords); the winner by summed recall first

heldOut.what: the 200 held-out first sentences of bench/knowledge.mjs drawHeldout (its DRAW_SEED), the same questions bench/verdicts/knowledge.json grades, graded once per cap after the rule was fixed

split.why: the rule and its parameters were fixed on records outside the draw before any pack was graded on the draw; every pack is a subset of the full store, whose ingest never wrote a hidden first sentence, and the leak count of every row is printed

control: the full store measured by the same code in the same session (full.control), and the null arm of bench/knowledge.mjs (the title alone: nullFirst, nullTop5)
recallBench: bench/recall.mjs takes --store DIR (its header line 10 and main()), but its command line writes bench/verdicts/recall.json or recall-partial.json, which this item does not own; so its graders (gradeWiki, modelAsked) are imported read-only and ask() is run on each pack the way its tier-on arm runs it (provider null, route direct, spawn off, knowledge = the pack): the askPath field of every row
writes: a pack is written under bench/fixtures/wiki/pack-<cap>/ (never committed): up to 200 MB for pack-200, which is kept; pack-100 and pack-50 are deleted after measuring (deletedAfterMeasuring in their rows)
bar: every cap (200, 100, 50 MB) packed under its bytes and measured: recall first and top five and ms per query on the same 200-question draw as the full store, leaks 0, the act/prompt.mjs reader opens it

statement: The encyclopedia the organism answers from (all 284749 Simple English Wikipedia articles, 1911943 facts, 388459374 bytes on disk) is not deployed with the site (bench/fixtures is never deployed, and docs/research/cloud-cell.md cites the platform function bundle limit it would have to fit), so tools/knowledge-pack.mjs writes smaller stores in the same format by one rule (cats-prior: the category prior of the WHOLE store (catdir.bin and catheads.txt, what the articles of each category are, counted from every visible first sentence, never a held-out one) is kept first, whole; then as cats-first: every article keeps its title and categories facts, articles in dump order; then its other facts breadth first in item order), under caps of 200, 100 and 50 MB counted over every file. The rule was chosen on the held-out records outside the graded draw, never on the draw. On the same 200 held-out questions the full store answers with recall first 62.5 and top five 78.5 percent in this session (bench/verdicts/knowledge.json recorded 62.5 and 78.5), against 9 and 13 for the title alone, and on 200 other articles whose own first sentence is in the store (the visible draw, seed knowledge-pack-visible-2026-09-27: retention, not recall of hidden text) with recall first 72 and top five 98.5; the packs: 200 MB: 199984995 bytes, 284749 of 284749 articles and 859769 of 1911943 facts, recall first 62 and top five 78 at 3.332 ms per query, visible recall first 72.5 and top five 98.5; 100 MB: 99984881 bytes, 284749 of 284749 articles and 303616 of 1911943 facts, recall first 59.5 and top five 77 at 3.03 ms per query, visible recall first 67 and top five 90.5; 50 MB: 49984699 bytes, 139238 of 284749 articles and 135364 of 1911943 facts, recall first 29 and top five 38 at 2.478 ms per query, visible recall first 31 and top five 42.5. The act/prompt.mjs reader opens every pack unchanged. The bar (every cap packed under its bytes and measured on both draws, the same draws as the full store, with no hidden sentence in any pack, by the rule chosen outside the draw, every number above printed by the bar commands) is met.
